name: Raptive SEO
author: Raptive

sections.description:
The Raptive SEO WordPress Plugin is the easiest way to connect your WordPress data with your Raptive dashboard. Capturing this data enables Raptive’s SEO features, including prioritized action items, performance monitoring, and tailored optimization guidance designed to help you grow your organic traffic and stay ahead of search trends.

What We Track

To deliver relevant, data-backed recommendations, the plugin monitors post-level updates, including:

  • Content changes: Captures edits to post titles, H1s, meta descriptions, main content, and large-scale revisions.
  • Media updates: Tracks changes to featured images and the number of images within a post.
  • SEO actions: Detects noindex/reindex status changes and redirect actions (Yoast-supported).
  • Author and metadata edits: Logs changes to post author, metadata, and updates to publish or modified dates—even when content stays the same.
  • Post publishing changes: Identifies post deletions, restorations, and same-day content reverts.

This data empowers Raptive to deliver insights tailored to your site and publishing habits, helping you optimize with confidence.

How will Raptive use this data?

Raptive will use the data only to provide the Services in accordance with Raptive’s agreement with you.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the Plugins screen in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Once the plugin is installed and activated, no further setup is required.
sections.faq:
Why does Raptive need this data?

We use WordPress data to understand how you update and manage content on your site. This allows us to deliver personalized SEO recommendations and build a deeper understanding of how search traffic is evolving, so you can take action quickly and stay ahead.
